altText: Watercolor panorama of Hues Floral Park at golden hour: a winding path between color-blocked dahlia beds, string lights strung above the beds, hills behind, the whole scene inside a painted paper border.
captionLong: The painting the main site opens with: the winding path between the color-blocked beds, string lights overhead, hills behind. It is the only wide panorama of the grounds in the collection, which is why a painting fronts a wing of photographs.
captionShort: The park in watercolor — beds, paths and string lights at golden hour.
title: Golden Hour Over the Beds

altText: Watercolor of Hues Floral Park in the evening — a curving stone path between cottage dahlia beds, string lights glowing overhead
captionShort: A curving stone path between the cottage beds, string lights glowing overhead.
title: Evening Over the Beds

altText: Photograph at dusk: visitors arranging buckets of dahlias at a picnic table, with string lights and the lawn behind them.
captionLong: The hero of the Floral Park page, and the dusk band on the desktop home page. Buckets of dahlias, a picnic table, string lights, and the light going down behind the lawn — the park's people moment.
captionShort: Buckets of dahlias being arranged at a picnic table as the light goes.
title: Visitors at Dusk
whereUsed: Floral Park page; home page (desktop and phone)

altText: Watercolor of dahlia beds at dusk under string lights, with glowing music notes drifting over the rows, inside a painted paper border.
captionLong: The hero of the Music page on both the desktop and phone sites — the painting that stands for the park's music wherever the music is introduced.
captionShort: Dusk over the dahlia beds, string lights on, notes in the air.
title: Music Over the Beds

altText: Watercolor of the cottage flower beds at Hues: a duck, a goose, Bella the dog and Hue the rabbit walk in procession up a stone path toward a rainbow at the vanishing point; the upper half of the painting is pale, empty sky.
captionLong: The painting the park's art is measured against — it opens the phone home. The upper half is pale sky, left empty on purpose; everything the picture is doing happens on the path below, where the procession is coming up between the beds toward the rainbow.
captionShort: The cottage beds, and the animals coming up the stone path.
title: The Procession

altText: Watercolor of Dusty the gardener, Hue the white rabbit and Cocoa the brown rabbit, all three in overalls, standing in front of the Hues Floral Park stand with dahlias in the foreground and string lights above. Painted lettering on the stand reads "HUES FLORAL PARK"; their name tags read "Dusty", "Hue" and "Cocoa".
captionLong: Painted for the arcade hub, where it still fronts the games. The lettering is part of the painting — HUES FLORAL PARK across the stand, and a name tag on each of the three.
captionShort: The arcade's own hero — Dusty, Hue and Cocoa in overalls in front of the stand.
title: Dusty, Hue & Cocoa

altText: Hue and Cocoa, the Hues Floral Park rabbits, in front of the Penny-Arcade Flowers stall: Hue, a white rabbit in green overalls, holds a microphone; Cocoa, a brown rabbit in pink overalls with a pink bow, stands beside her. The stall sign reads 'Hues Floral Park • Penny-Arcade Flowers'; their name tags read 'Hue' and 'Cocoa'.
captionShort: Hue and Cocoa at the penny-arcade flower stall.
title: The Penny-Arcade Flowers Stall
